intro: You are at Sinop Museum, in Sinop province, founded in 1941. In its garden, the remains of the Serapis temple are kept just where they were found, and inside, the collection tells the story of trade in Sinope, the Black Sea's port city.
history: During building work, the remains of a temple of Serapis came to light, and they are kept in place in the museum garden. Sinope held the best natural harbour on the Black Sea. The collection follows the trade that ran through it, from Milesian colony all the way to Ottoman shipyard.
highlights: As you wander, don't miss the remains of the Serapis temple and the amphora collection, then the icon hall and the ethnography section.
facts: Did you know? Sinopean amphorae turn up all round the Black Sea, and the stamps on them record which workshop made each one and in what year. And in the garden, the remains of a temple of Serapis, found during building work, are kept in place.
outro: This brings our journey through Sinop Museum to an end. Before you go, a small request: please leave the objects untouched and take your photographs without flash. Let these treasures stay bright for those who come after you. Enjoy your visit.
